_comment: GPU session 9 (round 11, Oct 25-26): test it all. Every option without a checked render gets one: bullet time by construction (S1), the moves (S2, mirrors and reframes made in code), ruin (S3), the three transitions that cut (S4), angle positions off the sheet (S5), quick mode of every keyframed move (S6), 4K (S8). Blocks run by name prefix with --only.
